name: pi-coordinator-guard
description: Per-category enforcement guard for the Pi coordinator main session: classifies tool calls (mutating bash, out-of-allowlist edit/write, spawn tag format and registry membership, /reload while dispatches are in flight); in enforce mode denies edit/write outside the allowlist, untagged dispatches and dispatches tagged with an unregistered project (coordinator-registry validated, 60s TTL cache, fail-open on registry read errors), mutating bash stays log-only, reload_safety is observe-only (restart_handoff.py library reuse). Live config file ~/.pi/agent/coordinator-guard.json (stat+mtime cache), env > config > observe precedence.
